<<E>> 3RD SPEED GEAR REMOVAL
1. Using special tool MD998917, support the 2nd speed gear, 
and then set them on the press.
2. Push down on the output shaft with the press and remove 
the 3rd speed gear.
<<F>> 2ND SPEED GEAR SLEEVE REMOVAL
1. Using special tool MD998917, support the 1st speed gear, 
and then set them on the press.
2. Push down on the output shaft with the press and remove 
the 2nd speed gear sleeve.
<<G>> 1ST SPEED GEAR SLEEVE REMOVAL
1. Using special tool MD998801, support the 1st speed gear 
sleeve, and then set them on the press.
2. Push down on the output shaft with the press and remove 
the 1st speed gear sleeve.
